title: Long-Term Budget Projections
description: CBO's extended baseline projections of revenues, spending, deficits, and debt over a 30-year horizon, typically expressed as a percentage of GDP.

notes.units: Summary projections are percentage of GDP unless otherwise noted. GDP itself is in trillions of dollars. Health care cost growth is in percentage points.
notes.horizon: Extends 20 years beyond the 10-year budget baseline.
